policy: No source enters model training unless its source-specific training permission is documented. Training permission and redistribution permission are separate decisions.

decision_record_fields.training_allowed: boolean; true only when the license/permission basis covers model training
decision_record_fields.basis: specific license clause, public-domain determination, or written permission identifier
decision_record_fields.evidence_url: stable source URL or private evidence reference

note: Empty by design: no current ANHC candidate source has yet passed the documented source-specific training-rights gate. Do not change this file to true based only on corpus ownership or a repository-level license badge.
